ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms mocked boundaries, real components and the mock-subject flag are declared; it does not run the tests.
offer: Mock costly external boundaries while exercising the real unit and its local collaborators. Mocking the unit itself proves only what the mock was told to return.

minimal.reason: List the costly external boundaries that are mocked. Mocking everything proves nothing, so name only true boundaries.

mid.reason: List the real components the unit uses. Without them the test checks a mock, so name the collaborators exercised.

maximal.reason: Set mocking the unit under test to false. A mocked unit proves only what the mock was told to return, so test the real one.

rule.reason: List the costly external boundaries that are mocked. Mocking everything proves nothing, so name only true boundaries.
